type Test_And_Set_Flag is mod 2 ** 8
  with Atomic, Default_Value => 0, Size => 8;

subprograms.name: Atomic_Clear
subprograms.code:
procedure Atomic_Clear
  (Item : aliased in out Test_And_Set_Flag)

subprograms.code:
